Implemented the Storybook setup end to end.

What changed:
- Wired shared Storybook runtime in [.storybook/preview.tsx](/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-20T10-26-20Z-82219c1d/project/.storybook/preview.tsx): real `src/styling/main.scss` plus `BaklavaProvider`.

- Replaced starter example stories with 11 colocated Baklava stories, 33 named story exports total, all with play assertions.
- Covered controls, form context, select/menu behavior, portal modal behavior, tabs, app/page/public layouts, property lists, banners, buttons, and empty states.
- Added exactly one computed-style CSS assertion in the Button story.
- Did not add MSW because the traced runtime has no direct app-owned `fetch`, storage, or cookie reads to mock/seed. Portals render to `document.body`, so no `preview-body.html` roots were needed.

Verification passed:
- `npx vitest --project storybook` → 11 files / 33 tests passed.
- `npm run check:types` → passed.
- `npx storybook build` → passed.
- Browser smoke via `agent-browser` against the AppLayout iframe showed the full shell rendering with nav, breadcrumbs, heading, and notifications region.

One note: the Storybook Vitest run logs React `act(...)` warnings from overlay/top-layer effects, but the tests complete successfully. The pre-existing untracked `.storybook/eval-results/prompt.md` was left untouched.

Implemented the Storybook setup end to end.

What changed:
- Wired shared Storybook runtime in [.storybook/preview.tsx](/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-20T10-26-20Z-82219c1d/project/.storybook/preview.tsx): real `src/styling/main.scss` plus `BaklavaProvider`.
- Added Vite pre-optimization in [vite.config.ts](/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-20T10-26-20Z-82219c1d/project/vite.config.ts) for Storybook browser-test stability.
- Replaced starter example stories with 11 colocated Baklava stories, 33 named story exports total, all with play assertions.
- Covered controls, form context, select/menu behavior, portal modal behavior, tabs, app/page/public layouts, property lists, banners, buttons, and empty states.
- Added exactly one computed-style CSS assertion in the Button story.
- Did not add MSW because the traced runtime has no direct app-owned `fetch`, storage, or cookie reads to mock/seed. Portals render to `document.body`, so no `preview-body.html` roots were needed.

Verification passed:
- `npx vitest --project storybook` → 11 files / 33 tests passed.
- `npm run check:types` → passed.
- `npx storybook build` → passed.
- Browser smoke via `agent-browser` against the AppLayout iframe showed the full shell rendering with nav, breadcrumbs, heading, and notifications region.

One note: the Storybook Vitest run logs React `act(...)` warnings from overlay/top-layer effects, but the tests complete successfully. The pre-existing untracked `.storybook/eval-results/prompt.md` was left untouched.
